question: rv32xmempool-invalid.s fails only because upstream changed the wording of the CSR missing-extension diagnostic. The fork behaviour is correct (csrr of 'trace' without +xmempool is still rejected at the same line:col 5:13; with -mattr=+xmempool it assembles to the same encoding [0xf3,0x22,0x00,0x7d]). No code fix is appropriate: restoring the old message would mean reverting upstream code in RISCVAsmParser.cpp for all CSRs. Recommend a test-regen task to update the single CHECK line in llvm/test/MC/RISCV/rv32xmempool-invalid.s from 'error: system register use requires an option to be enabled' to "error: system register 'trace' requires 'xmempool' to be enabled" (cosmetic: diagnostic text only, no instruction change). Approve?
